# Official VERI*FACTU reference documentation

Files under `/VERIFACTU` are reference material and are authoritative inputs for fiscal implementation.

Treat these files as read-only unless the developer explicitly asks to modify, reorganize, or replace documentation.

Do not "fix", reformat, normalize, rename, delete, or rewrite official AEAT examples, XSD, WSDL, PDFs, or other supplied documents on your own.

When reading documentation:

- distinguish normative rules from examples
- distinguish wire-contract details from domain concepts
- note document/version/date when relevant
- surface conflicts instead of guessing
- do not infer an omitted mandatory value from existing source code

The README in `/VERIFACTU` is only an index/helper. Original official documents remain authoritative.
